tools.name: movement.navigate
tools.knownDifference: Both Loader adapters use the same bounded deterministic A* contract and ordinary ServerPlayer input. Fabric 31/31 and Forge 3/3 GameTests verify door interaction, stairs/jumping, vertical swimming, ladder/vine climbing, observed entity avoidance, mid-route pause/resume, dynamic re-planning, unchanged hazard fixtures without health loss, moving follow targets, explicit owner stop, non-finite target rejection, unloaded-target non-loading with safe PAUSED evidence, and observed arrival. Separate two-process dedicated-server gates verify UUID/body/inventory recovery and safe PAUSED quarantine on both Loaders; passive user-takeover and combined-task breadth remain pending.
